# XTFrame-Backends: the GPU device backends of XTFrame (runtime/Docs/design/45-repository-layout.md §45.8) --
# xt_wgpu, xt_gl, Code/Backends, the C ABI's GPU target, xtframe-view, xtframe-gpu-probe and their tests --
# on top of the XTFrame runtime, which is the git submodule runtime/ (the XTFrame-Runtime commit of the same
# tag). Generated by Tools/Scripts/export_backends.sh in the XTFrame main repository (template
# Tools/Export/backends/CMakeLists.txt).
#
# The runtime's CMakeLists.txt is the build. It reads this repository's modules from XT_BACKENDS_SOURCE_DIR
# (this directory), at the paths and in the order the development repository has them, so the targets,
# options and compile flags are the development repository's; the options are the runtime's (README.md).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(XTFrameBackends LANGUAGES CXX C)

if(NOT EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime/CMakeLists.txt")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "runtime/ is empty: clone with --recurse-submodules, or run `git submodule update --init`")
endif()
set(XT_BACKENDS_SOURCE_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}")

# The executables, the xtframe library and the tests land in bin/<platform>_<arch>/<Config>[-<XT_BIN_VARIANT>]
# of this directory, as they do in the runtime built on its own (the runtime applies that default only when
# it is the top-level project). A parent project that adds this directory keeps CMake's default.
if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
    include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime/Tools/CMake/xt_runtime_output.cmake")
    xt_platform_tag(xt_backends_tag)
    set(xt_backends_bin "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/bin/${xt_backends_tag}/$<CONFIG>")
    if(DEFINED XT_BIN_VARIANT AND NOT XT_BIN_VARIANT STREQUAL "")
        string(APPEND xt_backends_bin "-${XT_BIN_VARIANT}")
    endif()
    set(XT_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIR "${xt_backends_bin}" CACHE STRING
        "Output directory of the executables (default: bin/<platform>_<arch>/<Config>[-<XT_BIN_VARIANT>]; empty: CMake default)")
endif()

# CTest reads the tests from the top-level build directory.
enable_testing()
add_subdirectory(runtime)
